name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Stacked sections in one frame: header rows on shared keylines, panels unfold from the header's keyline; one or many open.
whenToUse: Use it for several related sections a reader opens one or a few at a time, such as policies or FAQs. For a single disclosure use Collapsible; for views of one place use Tabs.

parts.name: AccordionHeader
parts.description: The heading that holds a trigger (Base UI Accordion.Header). AccordionTrigger renders one when it has none.

parts.name: AccordionItem
parts.description: A section: its header row and its panel (Base UI Accordion.Item).

parts.name: AccordionPanel
parts.description: The section's content (Base UI Accordion.Panel). It unfolds; its content sits inside the clip.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the content inside the panel's clip (its layout: `grid gap-4`).

props.name: flush
props.description: Drop the content's inset, for content that brings its own cells (an item list, a key/value grid).

parts.name: AccordionRoot
parts.description: Stacked sections in one frame. Each item is a header row and a panel; rows share keylines (one edge, one owner), and an open panel UNFOLDS from its header's bottom keyline (160ms, folds back in 120ms; the header row never moves). Opening does not also flood: the caret turns, the panel arrives. ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┬────┐ │ Customs documents 3 files │ ⌃ │ title (+ description) and meta · caret cell ├─────────────────────────────────────────┴────┤ │ panel content │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────┬────┤ │ Billing │ ⌄ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────┴────┘ The caret cell is the only divided column, so it runs straight down the frame whether or not a row has meta (a column, once started, runs the full height). One or many open (`multiple`), controlled or not, keyboard (Tab between headers, as the current APG pattern has it; Enter and Space toggle), heading semantics and find-in-page (`hiddenUntilFound`) are Base UI Accordion's.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: the rows sit directly in an enclosing frame (a panel body, an inspector).

parts.name: AccordionTrigger
parts.description: The header row (Base UI Accordion.Trigger): title, description and meta, and the caret cell.

props.name: description
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level of the header it renders when it is not inside an AccordionHeader (default 3).

props.name: meta
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Trailing text before the caret cell: a count, a status, a short code. It never wraps; the title does.
